name: Nintendo Entertainment System
description: Nintendo's 8-bit cartridge console, launched in Japan as the Family Computer (Famicom) and redesigned as a toaster-like 'entertainment system' for the West. Arriving after the 1983 North American market crash, it rebuilt home video gaming there and introduced Super Mario Bros., The Legend of Zelda and Metroid.

specs.sound: 5-channel APU inside the 2A03 (2 pulse, triangle, noise, DPCM)

curiosities: The Western NES contains a 10NES lockout chip that blocks unlicensed cartridges, the cause of the infamous blinking power light.
R.O.B. the robot was bundled at the US launch partly so retailers would stock the NES as a toy rather than a video game.
The Japanese Famicom's second controller has a built-in microphone, used in The Legend of Zelda to defeat Pols Voice enemies.
Games used mapper chips such as Nintendo's MMC3 inside the cartridge to bank-switch far more memory than the console could address on its own.
The Famicom launched in Japan in 1983 with Donkey Kong, Donkey Kong Jr. and Popeye.
